mapper.insert: INSERT INTO station (name, address, metro, city, rapid_cnt, slow_cnt, car_type, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{metro}, #{city}, #{rapidCnt}, #{slowCnt}, #{carType}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, metro, city, rapid_cnt, slow_cnt, car_type, latitude, longitude FROM station
SELECT id, name, address, metro, city, rapid_cnt, slow_cnt, car_type, latitude, longitude FROM station WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE address = #{address}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.address, s.metro, s.city, s.rapid_cnt, s.slow_cnt, s.car_type, s.latitude, s.longitude, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'IN_USE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_use_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'OUT_OF_SERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_service_cnt FROM station s LEFT JOIN charger c ON s.id = c.station_id
AND s.metro = #{metro}
AND s.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%')
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.address, s.metro, s.city, s.rapid_cnt, s.slow_cnt, s.car_type, s.latitude, s.longitude
